description: Test suite for WebSocket stream adapters, including WebSocketBasicStreamAdapter, WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter, and WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter, with various tests for connection, reading, writing, disconnection, and delegate behavior.

classes.name: WebSocketClientSocketHandleAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for ClientSocketHandle to provide simplified interface for WebSocket tests.

classes.name: WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SPDY WebSocket streams, handling request/response, reading, writing, and delegate notifications.

classes.name: WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for QUIC WebSocket streams, managing connection, data transfer, and delegate callbacks.

classes.name: MockDelegate
classes.description: Mock implementation of WebSocketSpdyStreamAdapter::Delegate for testing.

classes.name: MockQuicDelegate
classes.description: Mock implementation of WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter::Delegate for testing.

classes.name: TestWebSocketQuicStreamAdapterCompletionCallback
classes.description: Test callback class for asynchronous creation of WebSocketQuicStreamAdapter.

classes.name: KillerCallback
classes.description: Helper callback that destroys the adapter upon invocation to test destruction during callbacks.

methods.name: is_initialized
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocket stream adapter has been initialized with a socket handle.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes the underlying socket or stream connection.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into a buffer, handling synchronous and asynchronous cases.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream, handling synchronous and asynchronous cases.

methods.name: WriteHeaders
methods.description: Sends request headers over the stream.

methods.name: WriteHeaders
methods.description: Sends request headers over the stream.

methods.name: WriteHeaders
methods.description: Sends request headers over the stream.

methods.name: WriteHeaders
methods.description: Sends request headers over the stream.

methods.name: DetachDelegate
methods.description: Detaches the delegate to prevent further callbacks.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Returns a callback that destroys the adapter when invoked, used for testing destruction during callbacks.
